titulo: Uncle Ray Always Counted Us Before We Left the Lake #Shorts
titulo_pt: O tio Ray sempre contava a gente antes de sair do lago
resumo_pt: Todo verão, o tio Ray levava os sete sobrinhos ao lago e contava todos antes de ir embora. Um dia ele conta oito, fica pálido e leva todos para casa sem falar nada. Em casa, sob a luz da cozinha, conta de novo: sete. A virada: a mãe do narrador chega, vê as crianças e pergunta quem trouxe eles, porque o tio Ray se afogou naquele lago vinte anos antes do narrador nascer.
descricao:
Every summer, the same rule: count everyone before you leave the lake.

Who do you think the eighth one was?

Follow @VeilFrequency for a new horror story every day. Fictional story. Images are AI-generated.

scenes.text: Every summer, Uncle Ray took the seven of us cousins to the lake.
scenes.pt: Todo verão, o tio Ray levava nós sete, os primos, pro lago.
scenes.visual: faded summer afternoon at a quiet lake, wooden dock, kids silhouettes in the water

scenes.text: And before we left, he counted us. Every time.
scenes.pt: E antes de ir embora, ele contava a gente. Toda vez.
scenes.visual: man's silhouette on a dock pointing at a row of wet kids wrapped in towels, golden hour

scenes.text: He went pale. He didn't say a word. He just drove us home.
scenes.pt: Ele ficou pálido. Não falou nada. Só levou a gente pra casa.
scenes.visual: old station wagon driving down a dusk country road, kids silhouettes in the back window

scenes.text: In the kitchen, he lined us up under the light.
scenes.pt: Na cozinha, ele colocou a gente em fila embaixo da luz.
scenes.visual: row of kids standing in a dim farmhouse kitchen under a single hanging bulb

scenes.text: Then my mom walked in with the groceries.
scenes.pt: Aí minha mãe entrou com as compras.
scenes.visual: woman in a doorway holding paper grocery bags, backlit, frozen in place

scenes.text: We all turned to Uncle Ray. The kitchen was empty.
scenes.pt: Todos nós viramos pro tio Ray. A cozinha estava vazia.
scenes.visual: empty farmhouse kitchen, puddle of lake water on the floor where someone stood

scenes.text: Uncle Ray drowned in that lake twenty years before I was born.
scenes.pt: O tio Ray se afogou naquele lago vinte anos antes de eu nascer.
scenes.visual: old faded photograph of a young man on a lake dock, edges water-stained

scenes.text: And it wasn't eight he counted. It was us.
scenes.pt: E não era oito que ele contou. Era a gente.
scenes.visual: calm dark lake at night, wooden dock, mist, seven small towels left on the boards
